entities.title: Consular Services
entities.summary: The German Embassy in Islamabad and the German Consulate in Karachi provide various consular services, including notarizations, attestations, and certification of documents.
required_documents: Fee (cash in PKR) for issuing the Blocked Account Release Letter
Proof of an expired/cancelled visa (if applicable)
Withdrawn admission letter (certificate of registration) from the University in Germany (if applicable)
application_process: Book an appointment via the online link
entities.application_fee: 36€ (around 12,000 PKR depending on the current exchange rate of the Embassy)
important_notes: The Embassy can give no guarantee for the content, quality or cost of translations
Prior contact to the bank is recommended to confirm that the Consular Attestation is necessary
